stories.title: 📄 Research Report — Building No. 10 North (re-state.co.uk)
stories.summary: Key insights: (1) No 10 North must avoid being symbolic-only, too small, or 'business as usual' — it must expand real operational capacity, not just relocate staff; (2) it should be structured around four core units plus a Prime Minister's Transformation Directorate to drive mission delivery; (3) it needs new intergovernmental machinery to genuinely coordinate with Strategic Authorities and devolved administrations, learning from the Darlington Economic Campus's critical-mass approach; (4) success should ultimately mean Whitehall's centralised functions shrink as devolution matures; (5) the report stresses the 'first nine weeks' of operationalising No 10 North are critical to avoid the project failing without ever looking like a failure — a signal for how procurement, digital, and consulting engagements tied to the initiative may be structured early.
